full_page.content:
1936, July
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 131 July 28 Mrs. Donna Stumn - 27 - badly burned in May - has lost two babies now anxious ...
Mrs. Sheridan - 29 - sick 16 yrs. with something like cancer of liver & heart - went to confession To-night ....
29 Esther Jankowski - 22 Grand Rapids (beautiful modest) arthritis since 12. Enrolled To-day, promising weekly Communion instead of monthly.
H. Trif - 52 - broke leg June 24th now in cast Jennie Fox - 40 - Rupture.
Rose Kidd - 56 - methodist - cancer ... mole
Al. Fillip - 36 - has wife 2 children, drinks, careless with family, etc.
Blank Page
Page 132 Page 133 July 29 July Scallen - 45 - gangreenic poison - Drs. give no hope. Enrolled To-night perpetual member.
Warren Buckingham - 13 - very backward. Boy's father Convert and not well at all.
1936, August
August Aug. 3 Gert. Wildgen - 56 - broke leg last January. Still very lame Alive Needham - 55 - Cancerous liver .
4 Geo Fisher - 57 - non C.
Dr. Wm. J. Merdian - 66 - nervous
Anna Van Winkel .
Richard Steffy - 5 - infantile par. in Herman Kiefer. Aug. Hagedorn - 61 - cancer ... improving since prayed for
